description: Patch schema for local MMAudio video-to-audio generation through ComfyUI.

unmapped_ui_parameters.fps: The MMAudio sampler consumes loaded video frames and saves audio only; source video fps is handled inside VHS_LoadVideo.
unmapped_ui_parameters.width: Video dimensions are not resized in this audio-only workflow.
unmapped_ui_parameters.height: Video dimensions are not resized in this audio-only workflow.
unmapped_ui_parameters.MMAudioVoCoderLoader: The pinned 44k ComfyUI-MMAudio path auto-loads the local NVIDIA BigVGAN v2 snapshot from models/mmaudio/nvidia/bigvgan_v2_44khz_128band_512x inside MMAudioFeatureUtilsLoader. The explicit MMAudioVoCoderLoader is reserved for 16k mode and remains pinned/validated in nodes.lock.yaml.

output.contract: Comfy SaveAudio returns a single readable FLAC audio artifact at 44.1 kHz with duration matching the requested audio_length or the source-video-limited duration; MMAudioPlugin converts that local artifact to a real WAV before returning to the Blender UI path.
